properties.title: Venezuela Twin Earthquakes M7.2 + M7.5
properties.summary: Back-to-back earthquakes collapse buildings in Caracas; at least 32 killed, 700+ injured. State of emergency declared.

properties.title: Japan M6.9 Earthquake (NE Japan)
properties.summary: M6.9 earthquake in northeastern Japan. No tsunami warning issued.

properties.title: Super Typhoon Bavi
properties.summary: Active super typhoon in Western Pacific. Tracking toward Philippines/Luzon corridor.

properties.title: Ukrainian Strike: Orenburg Gas Processing Plant
properties.summary: Ukrainian SSO deep-strike units hit Orenburg GPZ and Russia's only helium plant (~1,500 km from frontline). Fires confirmed by satellite.

properties.title: Sevastopol Energy Infrastructure Attack
properties.summary: Sevastopol electricity cut for ~24h after Ukrainian attack on energy infrastructure. Power restored June 25.

properties.title: Russia: 323 UAVs Intercepted Overnight
properties.summary: Russian MoD reports 323 Ukrainian UAVs shot down over 20 regions. Zaporizhzhia gas infrastructure also hit by Geran-type drones.

properties.title: Tacloban Attack / Leyte School Threat Thwarted
properties.summary: Armed attack in Tacloban; potential school mass shooting stopped in Leyte. Interior Secretary seeks tougher gun laws.

properties.title: Rubio in Bahrain: GCC-US Iran Deal Meeting
properties.summary: US Secretary of State Rubio visiting Bahrain seeking Gulf backing for Iran deal and Hormuz freedom of navigation. Iran rejects Rubio's interpretation of peace MOU.

properties.title: Tropical Storm Douglas (Eastern Pacific)
properties.summary: Active tropical storm in eastern Pacific. Not threatening land currently.
